source: in-session Claude Code agent (pred-scout-coach) over each artifact role view (kit, build, stages, Eternal, lane augment, matchup verdicts, honesty notes) only; every number ground-checked, failing lines dropped

support.line: Open with Imperial Lash to root and dash onto the target, then Royal Flourish to mesmerize and Queen's Garden to slow them inside the thorns. Once Stonewall and Vainglory are done by minute 19, cast Iron Rose early and stand in front longer.
support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn, Narbash and Phase win this lane on our sim; don't Imperial Lash in first, hold Queen's Garden for their engage.

offlane.line: Open with Imperial Lash to root and close the gap, then Royal Flourish and Iron Rose to keep Thorns on them while you trade. Once Deathstalker completes around minute 16, take short fights on squishy targets and drop Queen's Garden to stop their escape.
offlane.watchout: Every listed offlaner wins this lane on our sim; against Greystone or Steel, farm under your tower instead of dashing in first.

offlane.line: Open with Web Lash to root, then Hellfire and Crushing Maw up close where it hits harder, and finish with Consume to pull them into the bite. Once Noxia completes around minute 16, stay in longer trades and heal through them with Crushing Maw.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Scarlett and Aurora win this lane on our sim; poke with Hellfire and skip all-ins until your jungler arrives.

jungle.line: Gank from terrain: Web Lash onto a wall, leap down to knock up and stun, then Consume to pull them into your bite and Crushing Maw to heal. After Noxia completes around minute 15, take longer skirmishes and hunt low targets for Consume's execute.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang win this matchup on our sim; don't duel them in the jungle, fight beside your laners instead.

midlane.line: Open with Dread Nova to stun, drop Ether Crystal on them to slow and pull them back to its center, then Particle Shredder while they're stuck. Once Spectral Schematics and Timewarp are done by minute 15, finish low targets with Synaptic Obliterator.
midlane.watchout: Every listed midlaner wins this lane on our sim; farm from max range and keep Ether Crystal to push divers off you.

support.line: Land Dread Nova to stun their carry, then Ether Crystal to slow them and pull them back to its center. Once Stonewall and Warden's Faith are done by minute 19, stand in front and drop Ether Crystal on your carry to push divers off them.
support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Narbash win this lane on our sim; hide behind minions and save Dread Nova to stun whoever engages.

offlane.line: Open with Glacial Charge to close in, stop it with Hoarfrost so the ring roots them, then Boreal Sweep to slow and Cryoseism to stun. Once Wraith Leggings completes around minute 16, take short trades and use the ice wall to cut off their escape.
offlane.watchout: Greystone wins this lane on our sim; don't start fights into him, farm safely and save Hoarfrost to root him when he engages.

jungle.line: Gank with Glacial Charge, cancel it into Hoarfrost to root them, then Boreal Sweep and Cryoseism so the stun lands. Once Orion completes around minute 15, chain ganks on squishy laners and let allies run along your ice wall.
jungle.watchout: Kwang wins this matchup on our sim; don't duel him in the jungle, gank lanes or take objectives on the far side.

support.line: Open with Glacial Charge onto their carry, stop it with Hoarfrost to root them, then Boreal Sweep to slow while your carry hits. Once Stonewall and Inquisition are done by minute 18, stand in front and save Cryoseism for whoever dives your carry.
support.watchout: Glacial Charge is also your main escape; never spend it to engage while your carry is out of position.

offlane.line: Leap in with Skull Crusher to shred their armor, Dire Howl to slow and buff yourself, then Cursed Edge and Kingslayer while they're marked. Once Spear Of Desolation completes around minute 16, take short fights on squishy targets and keep swinging when Berserk kicks in.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Scarlett, Aurora and Crunch win this lane on our sim; farm safely and only Skull Crusher in with your jungler close.

jungle.line: Gank with Skull Crusher to shred armor and gain speed toward them, Dire Howl to slow, then Kingslayer to lock them in the uppercut. Once Spear Of Desolation completes around minute 16, take short fights on squishy laners and lean on Dire Howl's heal.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera, Serath, Kwang and Feng Mao win this matchup on our sim; don't duel them, gank lanes and trade objectives instead.

jungle.line: Mark a target with Detection Protocol, follow the trail in, Chrono Swipe through them, then Primeval Roar to fear and Ursine Burst to grab and slam them. Once Deathstalker completes around minute 16, stick to squishy targets in short fights.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera, Serath, Kwang, Yurei and Feng Mao win this matchup on our sim; don't duel them, gank lanes where your laner can follow.

midlane.line: Shadow Slip in to slow, send Eventide through them so Blood Tithe applies Haemorrhage, then Feast for bonus damage that also heals you. Once Orion completes around minute 15, roam for picks and recast Shadow Slip to swap back out.
midlane.watchout: Gideon wins this lane on our sim; don't Shadow Slip into him first, farm safely and save Feast for when he's already low.

offlane.line: Shadow Slip in to slow, hit Blade Siphon and Eventide so Blood Tithe applies Haemorrhage, then Feast for bonus damage that heals you. Once Orion completes around minute 16, take short trades and recast Shadow Slip to swap back to safety.
offlane.watchout: Greystone wins this lane on our sim; keep trades short and recast Shadow Slip to swap out before he answers.

jungle.line: Gank with Shadow Slip to slow, Eventide and Blade Siphon to apply Haemorrhage, then Feast for bonus damage that heals you. Once Orion completes around minute 15, chain ganks on squishy laners and swap back with Shadow Slip to escape.
jungle.watchout: Feast leaps you into their team; only use it while Shadow Slip is ready to swap you back out.

offlane.line: Open with Forward Crunch to stun, then Right Crunch to slow and Left Crunch for the big hit, basic attacking between each to trim cooldowns. Once Basilisk completes around minute 16, use Re-Crunch right after your strongest hit to repeat it.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Scarlett and Aurora win this lane on our sim; farm safely and only dash in when your jungler arrives.

jungle.line: Gank with Forward Crunch to stun, then Right Crunch to slow and Left Crunch to hit hard, with a basic attack between each to lower cooldowns. Once Basilisk completes around minute 16, fire Re-Crunch right after Left Crunch to repeat it.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang win this matchup on our sim; don't duel them in the jungle, gank lanes and trade objectives instead.

support.line: Open with Stasis Bomb from a distance for a longer stun, then Photon Disruptor to slow and Containment Fence to trap them with your carry. Once Stonewall and Inquisition are done by minute 18, stand in front and drop Ion Strike so its center stuns.
support.watchout: A badly placed Containment Fence can block your own carry's chase; fence behind them, never between them and your team.

carry.line: Open with Old Rusty to slow, throw Gag Grenade to silence them, then Rad Rounds for fast basic attacks and Shrapnel Cannon to shred armor. Once Deathstalker completes around minute 16, keep attacking in longer fights and fire Shrapnel Cannon mid-air to escape dives.
carry.watchout: Murdock wins this lane on our sim; don't trade inside his range, farm safely and save Shrapnel Cannon's mid-air launch for his engage.

carry.line: Poke in ranged stance with Tachyon Lance, then Zero Shift to melee, Talon Drive in and spin Axiom Strike to build Heat for Limit Break. Once Viper completes around minute 16, stay in longer fights, since melee stance heals you off hero damage.
carry.watchout: Murdock and Drongo win this lane on our sim; stay ranged, farm safely and only go melee after your support lands a stun.

offlane.line: Trade in ranged stance with Tachyon Lance and Sidewind, then Zero Shift to melee and Talon Drive in once they're low, keeping damage flowing to build Heat. Once Viper completes around minute 16, take longer fights in melee stance to heal off hero damage.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Scarlett and Aurora win this lane on our sim; stay in ranged stance and only go melee with your jungler nearby.

midlane.line: Poke in ranged stance with Tachyon Lance and Sidewind's empowered Railshot, then Zero Shift to melee and Talon Drive onto a low target. Once Viper completes around minute 16, roam in melee stance and keep hitting heroes so Heat builds toward Limit Break.
midlane.watchout: Renna, Lt. Belica, Valmont, Gideon and Iggy & Scorch win this lane on our sim; stay ranged, farm with Tachyon Lance and skip all-ins.

jungle.line: Gank with Reaping Dash, Hamstring a lone target for bonus damage and the slow, then Earth Shatter to execute and recast on the next one. Once Augmentation completes around minute 16, dive into fights, since each takedown cuts most of Reaping Dash's cooldown.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang win this matchup on our sim; don't duel them, gank lanes and save Safeguard to block their key ability.

offlane.line: Raise Safeguard to block their poke, then Reaping Dash in and Hamstring a lone target, finishing with Earth Shatter's execute. Once Augmentation completes around minute 16, chase kills, since each takedown cuts most of Reaping Dash's cooldown.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Scarlett and Aurora win this lane on our sim; farm safely and only dash in when your jungler is coming.

midlane.line: Land a Sticky Mine and basic attack to empower it, then send Seek and Destroy and root them with Security Gate. Once Orion and Wraith Leggings are done by minute 15, trap groups inside Tesla Dome and stop escapes with Security Gate.
midlane.watchout: Gideon wins this lane on our sim; farm from max range and save Security Gate to root him when he engages.

support.line: Land a Sticky Mine on their carry and basic attack to empower it, then Security Gate to root them. Once Stonewall and Raiment of Renewal are done by minute 19, stand in front and drop Tesla Dome when their team groups up.
support.watchout: You have no dash; when they dive, run your carry through Security Gate for the speed boost and root the chaser.

offlane.line: Open with Sticky Mine and a basic attack to empower it, send Seek and Destroy to follow them, then root with Security Gate. Once Wraith Leggings completes around minute 16, push your lead and catch grouped enemies in Tesla Dome.
offlane.watchout: You have no dash to escape a gank; keep Security Gate ready to root whoever dives you.

midlane.line: Open with Void Breach to slow, drop Cosmic Rift on them, then basic attack to tether and root them, and cast Black Hole once they're stuck. Once Orion completes around minute 15, use Torn Space to reach a good Black Hole spot in team fights.
midlane.watchout: Black Hole locks you in place while it channels; cast it behind your frontline, never as the opener.

offlane.line: Leap in with Assault The Gates, spin Make Way to shred armor, slow with Sacred Oath, then Stone Forged Soul to heal before crashing down. Once Deathstalker completes around minute 16, push your lead with short fights on squishy targets.
offlane.watchout: A missed Assault The Gates leaves you stranded with no way out; leap only when your follow-up is ready.

jungle.line: Gank with Assault The Gates, spin Make Way to shred armor, slow with Sacred Oath, and save Stone Forged Soul to heal and crash down. Once Basilisk completes around minute 16, hit squishy targets in short fights.
jungle.watchout: Kwang wins this matchup on our sim; don't duel him in the jungle, gank lanes or take objectives on the far side.

carry.line: Raise Energy Shield to block their opener, then Assault Mode for long-range basic attacks, Displacement Blast to push divers away, and GTFO to finish fleeing targets. Once Deathstalker completes around minute 16, keep hitting from max range in longer fights.
carry.watchout: GTFO slows you while you lock on; fire it only when nobody can reach you.

offlane.line: Pull them in with Smash 'n Grab, cleave with Double Pain to heal, then Warlord's Challenge to stun and keep basic attacking so Bloodlust stacks. Once Basilisk completes around minute 16, chase with Stampede in short fights on squishy targets.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Scarlett, Aurora and Crunch win this lane on our sim; farm safely, heal with Double Pain and wait for your jungler.

jungle.line: Gank with Stampede to drag them, Smash 'n Grab to pull and stun, then Warlord's Challenge and basic attacks to stack Bloodlust. Once Basilisk completes around minute 16, take short fights on squishy targets and heal with Double Pain.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera, Serath and Kwang win this matchup on our sim; don't duel them in the jungle, gank lanes and trade objectives instead.

midlane.line: Lay your RMB grenade cluster to slow, drop a Land Mine to stun, then your Q missile from long range and Make It Rain. Once Oathkeeper and Spirit Of Amir are done by minute 15, poke from range and keep Land Mine for divers.
midlane.watchout: Gideon wins this lane on our sim; don't trade up close, poke from range and keep Land Mine to blast yourself out of danger.

offlane.line: Lay your RMB grenade cluster where they walk, Land Mine to stun, then fire your Q missile from range and finish with Make It Rain. Once Spirit Of Amir completes around minute 16, push your lead and poke them off the wave.
offlane.watchout: You're fragile up close; if they dive you, drop Land Mine at your feet to knock them away.

midlane.line: Set Flame Turret near the wave, basic attack to apply Slick, then roll Oil Spill and ignite it with Molotov so they burn. Once Soulbinder completes around minute 15, save Inferno for when they walk into your turrets.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and The Fey win this lane on our sim; play behind your turrets and don't push past them without your jungler.

offlane.line: Plant Flame Turret where you farm, roll Oil Spill and ignite it with Molotov, and keep basic attacks on them for Slick. Once Wraith Leggings completes around minute 16, fight inside your turret range and finish with Inferno.
offlane.watchout: Greystone wins this lane on our sim; fight beside your turrets, never away from them, and save Inferno's belch to knock him back.

support.line: Drop Flame Turret beside your carry, roll Oil Spill to slow their carry, then light it with Molotov so the oil burns. Once Stonewall and Warden's Faith are done by minute 19, stand in front and save Inferno for when they dive into your turrets.
support.watchout: Dekker wins this lane on our sim; keep turrets behind your minions and don't chase her through the wave.

carry.line: Land Narcosis to suspend them, drop Hydroclasm on top and pop it with Brine once it amplifies, then Genesis to knock them up. Once Wraith Leggings completes around minute 16, use your lane lead to push and poke from range.
carry.watchout: A missed Narcosis leaves nothing to stop divers; back off until it's ready again.

midlane.line: Throw Narcosis to suspend them, place Hydroclasm under them and pop it with Brine after it amplifies, then fire Genesis through walls to finish. Once Wraith Leggings completes around minute 16, last-hit with Brine for bonus gold and roam.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and Iggy & Scorch win this lane on our sim; farm with Brine from range and save Narcosis for their engage.

support.line: Land Narcosis on their carry, drop Hydroclasm on them and pop it with Brine once it amplifies so your carry gets free hits. Once Stonewall and Vainglory are done by minute 19, stand in front and save Genesis to knock up whoever dives.
support.watchout: Dekker wins this lane on our sim; stay behind your minions, poke with Brine and hold Narcosis until she commits.

jungle.line: Approach in Shadow Walk, open with Crippling Dagger to apply Death Mark, then Shadow Dance onto the marked target for double damage and Guillotine to finish. Once Spear Of Desolation completes around minute 15, hunt squishy carries caught alone.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang win this matchup on our sim; never duel them head-on, gank lanes and pick off isolated targets instead.

jungle.line: Gank with Ambush to leap in and slow, then Unleash for fast attacks and Cull to stun, saving Invigorate to cleanse their stuns and roots. Once Deathstalker completes around minute 16, keep fighting so your Rage keeps cooldowns rolling.
jungle.watchout: Kwang wins this matchup on our sim; don't start a fair duel with him, gank lanes or fight him with a laner beside you.

offlane.line: Ambush onto them once they're low for extra damage, Unleash for fast attacks, then Cull to stun, keeping Invigorate to cleanse their stuns. Once Spear Of Desolation completes around minute 16, take short fights on squishy targets.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel and Aurora win this lane on our sim; farm safely and only Ambush when your jungler is close.

carry.line: Stack Vengeance with basic attacks and Mercy, then Dusk to pop the stacks and slow, keeping Shadow Glide to dodge or chase. Once Deathstalker completes around minute 16, use Purge in fights to cut enemy healing while you shred them.
carry.watchout: Shadow Glide is your only escape; keep it ready before you commit to Purge.

jungle.line: Throw Judgement of the Heavens to tether them, Surge of the Heavens near the Blade to recall it and knock them up, then Fury of the Heavens to slow. Once Prophecy completes around minute 15, weave basic attacks while your Blade is Energized.
jungle.watchout: Fury of the Heavens teleports you to the Blade if it's out; check where it landed before you cast.

offlane.line: Throw Judgement of the Heavens to tether, use Light of the Heavens for the shield, then Surge of the Heavens back to the Blade for the knock-up. Once Prophecy completes around minute 16, trade longer with Energized basic attacks.
offlane.watchout: Greystone wins this lane on our sim; don't trade into him early, farm safely and fight only when your jungler arrives.

support.line: Tether their carry with Judgement of the Heavens, Surge of the Heavens near the Blade to knock them up, then Fury of the Heavens. After Stonewall and Raiment of Renewal are done by minute 19, front up and shield with Light of the Heavens.
support.watchout: Light of the Heavens only shields while you hold the Blade; recall it before their engage, not after.

carry.line: Fire Saturation Charge to slow, then follow with basic attacks and an Orbital Sanction that tracks them, keeping Frag Order to launch yourself away. Once Spectra completes around minute 15, drop Rally Point in fights to heal and speed your team.
carry.watchout: Every listed carry wins this lane on our sim; farm safely, keep Frag Order ready to escape, and let your support start fights.

midlane.line: Poke with Saturation Charge to slow, then drop Orbital Sanction on them and keep basic attacking, holding Frag Order to launch away. Once Viper completes around minute 16, plant Rally Point at fights so your team heals and you get infinite ammo.
midlane.watchout: Every listed midlaner wins this lane on our sim; farm from range, keep Frag Order for escape and wait for your jungler before trading.

offlane.line: Slow them with Saturation Charge, hold the wave with basic attacks, and drop Orbital Sanction when they commit, using Rally Point's knockback if they dive. Once Viper completes around minute 16, fight beside your team with Rally Point down.
offlane.watchout: Every listed offlaner wins this lane on our sim; farm under your tower and use Frag Order to launch away from their engage.

midlane.line: Place Void Drone near them, open with Seismic Assault to stun, drop Void Bomb on the stunned target, then finish with Neural Disruptor once their mana is drained. Once Soulbinder completes around minute 15, look for picks on squishy targets.
midlane.watchout: Gideon, Iggy & Scorch and The Fey win this lane on our sim; farm from range and save Seismic Assault for their engage.

support.line: Open with Seismic Assault to stun them, drop Void Bomb on the stunned target, then finish with Neural Disruptor. Once Stonewall and Vainglory are done by minute 19, stand in front and soak hits while your stuns land.
support.watchout: Dekker wins this lane on our sim; drop Void Drone for vision, stay behind your carry, and save Seismic Assault for whoever dives.

support.line: Throw Maco Sparkle! and detonate it on them for the stun, follow with Maco Fly! to slow and shield yourself, and save Maco Gift! to heal your carry. Once Noxia and Oblivion Crown are done by minute 19, heal harder through longer fights.
support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker and Mourn win this lane on our sim; don't leap in first with Maco Fly!, stay back and stun whoever dives your carry.

midlane.line: Mark your target with RMB, slow them with Q Hive, run through them with E Swarm to stack Pestilence, then finish with R Curse on the marked target. Once Spectral Schematics and Orion are done around minute 15, take longer trades.
midlane.watchout: Against Gideon this lane loses on paper; farm with Hive from range and save Swarm to escape instead of diving in.

offlane.line: Mark your target with RMB, slow them with Q Hive, run through them with E Swarm to stack Pestilence, then cast R Curse on the marked target. Once Spectral Schematics and Orion are done around minute 16, start trades more often.
offlane.watchout: Curse only hits a marked target; if nobody is marked, don't dive with Swarm, back off until Mark is ready again.

support.line: Pull a target in with RMB Abduct, then hold E Beguile to mesmerize them, and drop Q Contagion so your carry heals and gets tougher. Once Noxia and Wraith Leggings are done around minute 19, your heals carry longer fights.
support.watchout: Against Riktor or Dekker, don't channel Abduct out in the open; stay behind your carry and use Beguile to stop whoever dives.

offlane.line: Pull a target in with RMB Abduct, hold E Beguile to mesmerize them, then drop Q Contagion to weaken their armor while you hit. Once Spectral Schematics and Oathkeeper are done around minute 16, stay in longer trades.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone, Steel, Scarlett or Aurora this lane loses on paper; farm near your tower and save Beguile for when they dive.

carry.line: Set Static Trap where they walk, poke with basic attacks until Shots Fired is ready, then blast with RMB Buckshot and chase with E Hot Pursuit. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, stand and trade basic attacks longer.
carry.watchout: Kneeling for Long Arm of the Law with nobody in front of you gets you killed; fire it from behind your team.

offlane.line: Set Static Trap at your feet, poke with basic attacks until Shots Fired is ready, and push divers off you with RMB Buckshot. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, stand and trade basic attacks longer.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone, Steel or Aurora, don't trade up close; trap the lane, farm near your tower and Buckshot them away.

support.line: Fully charge RMB Serenity to stun, drop Q Consecrated Ground under your carry, and throw E Alacrity to shield them, saving R Reversal Of Fortune to save an ally anywhere. Once Oblivion Crown and Lunaria are done around minute 18, your shields hit harder.
support.watchout: Against Riktor, Dekker or Mourn, don't stand in front charging Serenity; stay behind your carry and shield first.

support.line: Stun with RMB Thunk, use Q March! to rush your team in or out, then start R Crash Bang Boom! in the middle of the fight. Once Wraith Leggings and Oblivion Crown are done around minute 20, you can stay in fights longer.
support.watchout: Against Riktor or Dekker this lane loses on paper; keep Thunk to stop their engage instead of opening with it.

midlane.line: Slow them with E Data Burst, send Q L.I.N.X through them, then dash with RMB Erase Vector for an empowered Jolt; every fourth ability is Overclocked. Once Spectral Schematics and Oathkeeper are done around minute 16, chain R Final Thread into its recast bomb.
midlane.watchout: Against Lt. Belica, Gideon or Iggy & Scorch this lane loses on paper; farm from range and save Erase Vector to dash away.

support.line: Link your carry with RMB Telekinetic Link, blind them with Q Psychic Flare, root with E Energy Lance, then pop R Hyperflux so you both hit faster. Once Stonewall and Vainglory are done around minute 19, you can take more hits for your carry.
support.watchout: Against Riktor, Dekker or Mourn, stay behind your carry and reactivate Telekinetic Link to pull them out before they get locked down.

jungle.line: Carry Q Boulder Throw into a gank, throw it to stun, then RMB Pounce in and E Rumble to keep them slowed. Once Viper and Spear Of Desolation are done around minute 15, pop R Behemoth to throw boulders instantly and stay in fights.
jungle.watchout: Against Khaimera, Kwang or Feng Mao this jungle loses on paper; skip their camps, gank lanes instead, and fight only with a teammate beside you.

midlane.line: Open with E Stupor to mesmerize, drop Q Mortal Coil on them, then fire RMB Soulfire while you walk over Essence to power up. Once Spectral Schematics and Oathkeeper are done around minute 16, use R Abyssal Rift to jump into fights.
midlane.watchout: Lt. Belica, Gideon, Iggy & Scorch and The Fey all beat this lane on paper; farm from range and hold Stupor for whoever dives you.

support.line: Mesmerize with E Stupor from behind your carry, drop Q Mortal Coil to pull them in, then fire RMB Soulfire while your carry hits them. Once Stonewall and Warden's Faith are done around minute 19, step forward and soak hits for your carry.
support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Narbash beat this lane on paper; stay behind your carry and hold Stupor for whoever engages.

carry.line: Land E Scar first, then basic attack to burn the marks into a root, and fire Q Obliterate since its missiles chase the marked target. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, use R Reckoning to pull one target away and duel them.
carry.watchout: Sparrow, TwinBlast, Murdock, Drongo and Eden beat this lane on paper; farm behind your support and save Reckoning until your items land.

midlane.line: Land E Scar first, then basic attack to burn the marks into a root, and fire Q Obliterate since its missiles chase the marked target. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, use R Reckoning to isolate one target.
midlane.watchout: Every listed mid matchup beats this pick on paper; don't trade early, farm from range and wait for your items before using Reckoning.

support.line: Hook a target with RMB Riplash, silence them with Q Shock Therapy, and turn on E Electrocute while your carry hits them; save R Skewer to hold several enemies. Once Stonewall and Vainglory are done around minute 19, you can walk in first.
support.watchout: Against Dekker this lane loses on paper; don't throw Riplash blindly, stay near your carry and use Shock Therapy to stop her engage.

jungle.line: Pull a target with RMB Riplash, silence with Q Shock Therapy, then keep basic attacking with E Electrocute on; use R Skewer to hold the group. Once Spectra and Prophecy are done around minute 15, your basic attacks carry longer fights.
jungle.watchout: Against Khaimera or Kwang this jungle loses on paper; avoid their camps, gank lanes instead, and fight only with a teammate nearby.

offlane.line: Pull a target with RMB Riplash, silence with Q Shock Therapy, then keep basic attacking with E Electrocute on; save R Skewer for when your jungler arrives. Once Spectra and Prophecy are done around minute 15, stay in longer trades.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone, Steel or Aurora this lane loses on paper; farm near your tower and only hook them when your jungler is close.

offlane.line: Dash in with E First Intent for the shield, swing Q Ashen Vow so the outer edge slows them, then finish low targets with RMB Minueta. Once Augmentation and Viper are done around minute 16, open with R Swan Song to lock one target.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone, Steel or Aurora this lane loses on paper; farm near your tower and keep First Intent to escape instead of diving.

jungle.line: Dash in with E First Intent for the shield, swing Q Ashen Vow so the outer edge slows them, then finish low targets with RMB Minueta. Once Augmentation and Viper are done around minute 16, open ganks with R Swan Song to lock one target.
jungle.watchout: Against Khaimera or Kwang this jungle loses on paper; don't duel them in their camps, gank lanes instead and fight with a teammate beside you.

jungle.line: Dive in with E Ascend, clap RMB Chastise to slow, then Q Heaven's Fury to strike; pop R Heresy when the fight starts. After a takedown, touch the visage for a free Heresy, especially once Viper and Spear Of Desolation are done around minute 15.
jungle.watchout: Against Khaimera or Kwang this jungle loses on paper; avoid solo duels in their jungle and gank lanes with help instead.

offlane.line: Dive in with E Ascend, clap RMB Chastise to slow, then Q Heaven's Fury to strike and reposition; pop R Heresy for the fight. Once Viper and Spear Of Desolation are done around minute 16, chain takedowns by touching the visage for free Heresy.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone, Steel, Scarlett or Aurora this lane loses on paper; farm near your tower and only dive with Ascend when your jungler arrives.

offlane.line: Dash through them with RMB Phantom Rush to fear, drop E Subjugate to chain them in place, then Q Siphon to steal health. Once Spectral Schematics and Timewarp are done around minute 16, finish fights with R Colossal Blow.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone or Aurora this lane loses on paper; farm with Siphon near your tower and wait for your jungler.

jungle.line: Gank with RMB Phantom Rush to fear, drop E Subjugate to chain them in place, then Q Siphon to steal health. Once Spectral Schematics and Timewarp are done around minute 15, use R Colossal Blow to knock divers away or finish fights.
jungle.watchout: Against Khaimera or Kwang this jungle loses on paper; avoid their camps, gank lanes instead and fight only with a teammate nearby.

offlane.line: Dash in with RMB Rushing Beat, send Q Line Tempo through them, and cast E Circle Rhythm for the shield; every ability hit builds Track toward R All-Kill!. Once Spectral Schematics and Timewarp are done around minute 16, cast All-Kill! on every marked enemy.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone or Steel this lane loses on paper; farm with Line Tempo from range and keep a Rushing Beat charge to escape.

jungle.line: Gank with RMB Rushing Beat, send Q Line Tempo through them, and cast E Circle Rhythm for the shield; every ability hit builds Track toward R All-Kill!. Once Spectral Schematics and Timewarp are done around minute 15, finish marked enemies with All-Kill!.
jungle.watchout: Against Khaimera or Kwang this jungle loses on paper; skip their camps, gank lanes instead and keep a Rushing Beat charge to escape.

carry.line: Slow them with Q Plasma Grenade, lift off with E Air Assault for extra range, then turn on RMB Hypercharge and keep shooting; finish low targets with R Atomiser. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, stay in longer trades.
carry.watchout: Sparrow, TwinBlast, Murdock and Drongo beat this lane on paper; farm behind your support and save Air Assault to dodge their trades.

carry.line: Slow them with Q Hail of Arrows, keep basic attacking to stack Relentless, then fire RMB Piercing Shot; use E Heightened Senses to reset a bad trade. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, open fights with R Inner Fire.
carry.watchout: Against TwinBlast, Murdock, Drongo or Eden this lane loses on paper; farm with Piercing Shot from range and keep Heightened Senses to escape.

offlane.line: Charge in with Q Bull Rush, stun with RMB Shield Bash, and drop E Force Shield to block their shots while you trade. Once Spectral Schematics and Oathkeeper are done around minute 16, jump in with R Shield Slam to stun the group.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone or Aurora this lane loses on paper; farm near your tower and save Bull Rush to escape instead of engaging.

support.line: Charge in with Q Bull Rush, stun with RMB Shield Bash, and drop E Force Shield to block shots aimed at your carry. Once Stonewall and Vainglory are done around minute 19, open fights with R Shield Slam and soak the hits.
support.watchout: Against Dekker this lane loses on paper; stay beside your carry and keep Force Shield up for them instead of rushing in.

jungle.line: Gank by charging in with Q Bull Rush, stun with RMB Shield Bash, and drop E Force Shield to block their escape shots. Once Spectral Schematics and Oathkeeper are done around minute 16, jump into fights with R Shield Slam to stun the group.
jungle.watchout: Against Khaimera or Kwang this jungle loses on paper; avoid their camps, gank lanes instead and fight only with a teammate nearby.

offlane.line: Throw E Highland Hurl to slow, spin Q Ruthless Assault, and basic attack to fill Hersir so your next ability is empowered; use RMB Wild Rush to chase. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, pop R Unstoppable Force to dive under towers.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Scarlett and Aurora beat this lane on paper; farm near your tower, where Terra gets tougher, and wait for your jungler.

jungle.line: Gank with RMB Wild Rush, throw E Highland Hurl to slow, spin Q Ruthless Assault, and basic attack to fill Hersir for an empowered ability. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, pop R Unstoppable Force to dive under towers.
jungle.watchout: Against Khaimera or Kwang this jungle loses on paper; avoid their camps, gank lanes instead and fight only with a teammate nearby.

midlane.line: Throw E Harvest Nettles at the same target again and again, drop Q Bramble Patch to slow them, then land RMB Untamed Growth on top. Once Spectral Schematics and Wraith Leggings are done around minute 16, pull the group with R Fly Trap.
midlane.watchout: Against Gideon this lane loses on paper; farm from range with Harvest Nettles and keep Bramble Patch between you and him.

support.line: Poke one target with E Harvest Nettles, drop Q Bramble Patch to slow anyone diving your carry, and land RMB Untamed Growth on slowed enemies. Once Stonewall and Warden's Faith are done around minute 19, step forward and start fights with R Fly Trap.
support.watchout: Before your tank items land you are fragile; wander ahead of your carry and you get caught alone, so stay with them and poke.

carry.line: Slow them with RMB Vortex Grenade, fire Q Vaporize, then basic attack right after each ability for the triple shot; every hit shortens E Rocket Dash. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, unload R Ventilate in longer fights.
carry.watchout: Against Murdock or Drongo this lane loses on paper; farm behind your support and keep Rocket Dash ready to escape their trades.

offlane.line: Slow them with RMB Vortex Grenade, fire Q Vaporize, then basic attack right after each ability for the triple shot; keep E Rocket Dash to get away. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, unload R Ventilate in longer fights.
offlane.watchout: Nearly every listed offlane matchup beats this pick on paper; farm near your tower and save Rocket Dash to escape their engage.

midlane.line: Slow them with RMB Vortex Grenade, fire Q Vaporize through the wave, then basic attack right after each ability for the triple shot. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, unload R Ventilate in longer fights.
midlane.watchout: Every listed mid matchup beats this pick on paper; farm from range and keep Rocket Dash ready to escape.

midlane.line: Hit them with E Bloodbound for attack speed, bind them with RMB Arterial Grip, then keep basic attacking so Lilith keeps striking; add Q Rupture. Once Spectral Schematics and Wraith Leggings are done around minute 16, use R Exsanguinate to heal through longer fights.
midlane.watchout: Lt. Belica, Gideon, Iggy & Scorch and The Fey beat this lane on paper; farm from range and bind only with your jungler nearby.

offlane.line: Hit them with E Bloodbound for attack speed, bind them with RMB Arterial Grip, then keep basic attacking so Lilith keeps striking; add Q Rupture. Once Spectral Schematics and Wraith Leggings are done around minute 16, use R Exsanguinate to heal through longer trades.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone, Steel or Aurora this lane loses on paper; farm near your tower and bind only when your jungler is close.

carry.line: Throw Q Peekaboo! to slow and mark them, then fire RMB Knock, Knock! at the marked target and keep basic attacking. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, trade longer and use R Back It Up! to drag a fleeing enemy back.
carry.watchout: Against Sparrow, TwinBlast, Murdock or Drongo this lane loses on paper; farm with Knock, Knock! from range and keep Surprise, Surprise! to escape.

midlane.line: Throw Q Peekaboo! to slow and mark them, then fire RMB Knock, Knock! at the marked target and keep basic attacking. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, use R Back It Up! to drag a fleeing enemy back into your team.
midlane.watchout: Every listed mid matchup except Argus beats this pick on paper; farm with Knock, Knock! from range and keep Surprise, Surprise! ready to escape.

support.line: Throw Q Peekaboo! to slow and reveal enemies for your carry, follow with RMB Knock, Knock! on the marked target, and drop your Sonar Drone to watch for ganks. Once Stonewall and Warden's Faith are done around minute 19, step in front more.
support.watchout: Every listed support matchup beats this pick on paper; stay behind your carry, poke from range and keep Surprise, Surprise! to escape.

jungle.line: Dash in with RMB Windsurge in Spirit stance, throw E Cyclebreaker to stun, then switch stance with R and keep basic attacking to spawn Clones. Once Viper and Solaris are done around minute 16, Pole Vault onto their damage dealers in the back.
jungle.watchout: Against Khaimera, Serath, Kwang or Feng Mao this jungle loses on paper; skip solo duels in their camps; gank lanes with a teammate.

offlane.line: Dash in with RMB Windsurge in Spirit stance, throw E Cyclebreaker to stun, then switch stance with R and keep basic attacking to spawn Clones. Once Viper and Solaris are done around minute 16, trade longer with Pole Vault for extra attack speed.
offlane.watchout: Every listed offlane matchup beats this pick on paper; farm near your tower and only fight when your jungler arrives.

jungle.line: Pull in with Q Lash Kick to slow them, basic attack to stack Rising Storm, and turn on E Windburn for reach; RMB Backlash reflects incoming shots. Once Solaris and Viper are done around minute 16, pop R Quelling Gale to block projectiles.
jungle.watchout: Every listed jungle matchup beats this pick on paper; never duel the enemy jungler alone, gank lanes with your teammates instead.

offlane.line: Pull in with Q Lash Kick to slow them, basic attack to stack Rising Storm, and turn on E Windburn to hit from range; RMB Backlash reflects incoming shots. Once Solaris and Viper are done around minute 16, pop R Quelling Gale to block projectiles.
offlane.watchout: Every listed offlane matchup beats this pick on paper; farm near your tower and only Lash Kick in when your jungler arrives.

jungle.line: Fire RMB Whispering Echoes to apply Soul Rip, rush through them with E Severance to reset it, then spin Q Anima Burst to heal. Once Viper and Solaris are done around minute 16, channel R Soulstorm to pull the group in and reset Severance.
jungle.watchout: Against Khaimera, Serath, Kwang or Feng Mao this jungle loses on paper; avoid solo duels in their camps and gank lanes with a teammate instead.

offlane.line: Fire RMB Whispering Echoes to apply Soul Rip, rush through them with E Severance to reset it, then spin Q Anima Burst to heal. Once Viper and Solaris are done around minute 16, channel R Soulstorm to pull them in and reset Severance.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone, Steel, Scarlett or Aurora this lane loses on paper; farm near your tower and keep Severance to escape.

offlane.line: Raise Q Barricade to block their trade, swing it to stun, then thrust RMB Spear of Nyr and chase with E Evade. Once Viper and Spear Of Desolation are done around minute 16, leap onto a low target with R Coliseum to finish them.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone this lane loses on paper; farm near your tower and save Barricade to block his engage.

jungle.line: Raise Q Barricade to block damage, swing it to stun, then thrust RMB Spear of Nyr and chase with E Evade. Once Viper and Spear Of Desolation are done around minute 15, leap onto a low target with R Coliseum to finish them.
jungle.watchout: Leaping in with Coliseum before your team arrives gets you surrounded and killed; wait for a teammate and keep Evade to escape.

support.line: Stun with Q Ricochet, slow with E Bad Medicine, and keep RMB Infuse on your carry; cast R Neural Regenesis on them before a fight turns. Once Oblivion Crown and Lifecore are done around minute 19, your heals carry longer fights.
support.watchout: Every listed support matchup beats this pick on paper; stay behind your carry, heal instead of trading, and save Ricochet for divers.

offlane.line: Poke with basic attacks to stack their damage over time, stun with Q Ricochet, and drop E Bad Medicine to slow them while you keep hitting. Once Spectral Schematics and Oathkeeper are done around minute 16, start longer trades with your jungler nearby.
offlane.watchout: Every listed offlane matchup beats this pick on paper; farm near your tower and save Ricochet to stop whoever dives you.
